notes: Company snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) with sticky trial funnel; search/recs part of core product.
Primary contact: Clara Diaz (PM) - focused on measurables: NDCG, CTR lift on help center and product doc search.
POC ask: 2-week reranking POC that runs on ~3M doc candidates, accepts candidate lists from their Elastic cluster and returns ranked IDs + normalized scores.
Quality targets: +4-7% NDCG@10 vs BM25 baseline across three gold query sets. PM quote: "If we can't beat BM25 by signal we won't ship."
Latency/throughput: online rerank SLO 95th <= 120ms for single-query rerank (10–100 candidates), global target 50–150ms; batch/offline scoring must support 100k+ items/hour for nightly re-ranks.
Operational needs: ability to run offline scoring (batch API or containerized job), export scores for offline eval and feature store, and integrate scoring into ranking pipeline without reindexing.
Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to smaller quantized model or Hosted fallback regionally during Dedicated capacity scaling.
Security constraints: mandate SSO for admin; audit logs retention 12 months; KMS for keys; some enterprise customers require EU data residency for search logs.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market — constrained POC budget. Prefers Hosted for POC (lower friction) then evaluate Dedicated if cost/unit token + throughput wins out.
Evaluation plan: use Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + quantization profiles, run regression tests on held-out eval sets, track NDCG/MRR/precision at K in console.
Integration note: engineering requests node/python SDK examples and a small Java connector that converts Elastic candidate payload to Redwood rerank format.
Blockers called out on calls: purchasing prefers net-30 terms for Dedicated; security wants artifact that shows audit log retention guarantees and SOC2 scope.
